text.en: These rules may be cited as the Registration of Guests (Fur-Citation nishing of Returns) Rules.

The Keeper of any specified premises shall on every Monday Prescribed furnish to the nearest Police Station returns as to the persons lodging at time the premises during the week prior to the date of furnishing such returns. ~
The returns shall be in the form in the Schedule to the Registra-Prescribed tion of Guests Act. particulars B.L.R.O. 111984
